title: How much Data do We Need? Sequential Data Collection for Stochastic Programming
summary: Data-driven optimization often requires collecting data to estimate uncertain model parameters before solving the underlying decision problem. In practice, however, data acquisition may incur non-negligible costs, making it critical to determine when to stop additional data collection. In this paper, we study an optimal stopping problem for sequential data collection in stochastic optimization under parameter uncertainty.
